## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-*juan* Northern-Sòng auxiliary liturgical apparatus by **Zūnshì** 遵式 (964–1032) — the Tiāntái-Pure Land synthesis master of Háng-zhōu Tiānzhú-sì and the most prolific compiler of repentance liturgies in Sòng Buddhism — for the *Jīn-guāng-míng* (Suvarṇaprabhāsa-sūtra) repentance practice. Body attribution: *Sòng Tiāntái Dōngyè-shān shāmén Zūnshì jí* 宋天台東掖山沙門遵式集.

**Abstract**

Zūnshì's *Bǔ-zhù yí* belongs to his comprehensive late-Northern-Sòng liturgical apparatus, alongside his other major repentance compilations (the *Wǎngshēng jìng-tǔ chàn-yuàn yí* 往生淨土懺願儀 T1984 and the *Pǔ-mén pǐn chóng-sòng* [KR6d0056](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0056)). Through Zūnshì's productive activity, the *Jīn-guāng-míng* (Suvarṇaprabhāsa) devotional cult became one of the standard institutional liturgies of Sòng Tiāntái-Pure Land devotional practice.
